description: Selection and merge rules for the Star Map houses reading. Implemented by build/compose.py; the app should port this file, not re-derive it.

rulers.note: Chart ruler = traditional ruler of the rising sign; the modern co-ruler is named in brackets only. The existing UI 'Ruling Planet' row is the Sun sign's MODERN ruler and must be relabelled (see ui_labels).

full.when: birth time AND birth place known

solar.when: birth time unknown (any place), OR time known but place unknown
solar.label: Solar chart: we don't have your birth time and place, so your Sun sign is used as your 1st house. Your rising sign and the exact houses need a birth time.
solar.house_rule: solar whole sign: house = ((planet_sign - sun_sign) mod 12) + 1
solar.unstable_planets: A planet is used only if its sign is the same across the whole uncertainty window: local 00:00-23:59 when the place is known, otherwise UTC-12 to UTC+14 around the date. Otherwise omit it and say so once.
solar.time_known_place_unknown: Same as solar. Do NOT assume UTC: the current engine silently uses offset 0 when geocoding fails (lib/profile.ts + lib/western-astrology.ts:153). Only show the Moon sign if it is stable across UTC-12..+14.

sun_rising.select: combinations: subtype sun_rising matching sun.sign + asc.sign

chart_ruler.bridge: if combinations.chart_ruler_with_sun matches (ruler in the Sun's house), render the chart ruler entry as its teaser (first teaser_cut sentences) followed by the FIRST sentence of chart_ruler_with_sun, because the sun_house paragraph already covers that house

moon_house.combo: if combinations sun_moon_house_{sun}_{moon} matches: render moon_house as teaser (first teaser_cut sentences) followed by the combination in full

angular.select: planet_in_house for planets in houses 1, 10, 7, 4 (that order), excluding sun, moon and any planet already used
angular.order_within: personal planets (mercury, venus, mars) before social (jupiter, saturn) before outer

emphasis.select: largest matching stellium (tie: the house holding the Sun, then the chart ruler, then the lowest house number); if none, a matching hemisphere entry; if none, a matching quadrant entry
emphasis.extra_stelliums: render as share_line in the 'more' list
emphasis.featured_house_rule: if the stellium's house is the Sun's house or the chart ruler's house, render only its teaser plus the stellium_count template (the house itself is already described)

venus_house.select: venus_house_{HH} (skip if Venus is already used, e.g. as chart ruler; the free locked card then points at the chart-ruler paragraph)

career.note: keyed to the MC sign, which in whole sign can fall in the 9th, 10th or 11th house; say 'Midheaven' in titles, not '10th house sign', if MC house != 10

rest.select: remaining planet_in_house entries for mercury, mars, jupiter, saturn, uranus, neptune, pluto not yet used

personal.select: mercury_house_{HH}, mars_house_{HH} (solar houses) if not already used
personal.note: solar mode only, so a no-time reading still has enough paid substance

limits.overflow: drop lowest-priority full paragraphs to share_line first; never drop slots priority <= 3

dedup: Each library entry id appears at most once per reading.
If a planet is selected by two slots (e.g. Venus is both chart ruler and 7th ruler), render it once in the higher-priority slot and use a connective template in the other.
Drop a final growth-edge sentence from every paragraph after the first two that keep one (never below min_sentences_after_trim).
If two full paragraphs share >= 3 tags, demote the lower-priority one to its share_line.
Sign descriptions already shown by the existing Sun/Moon/Rising cards are not repeated: the library never restates sign traits beyond one clause.
tension_template: Your chart holds both a {a} streak and a {b} one. Rather than one cancelling the other out, they often take turns, and a lot of your range can come from giving each its own time and place.

connective_templates.seventh_ruler: The ruler of your 7th house is {planet}, which sits in your {house_ord} house, so partnership themes often play out through {house_theme}.
connective_templates.seventh_ruler_already_used: {planet_cap}, already covered above, is also the ruler of your 7th house, so what it says about {house_theme} tends to colour your close relationships too.
connective_templates.seventh_ruler_is_chart_ruler: {planet_cap} rules both your rising sign and your 7th house, so how you show up and who you are drawn to tend to be closely linked.
connective_templates.unstable_omitted: Your {planet_list} changed sign around your birth date, so we've left {pronoun} out until we have a birth time.
connective_templates.mc_not_10th: In whole sign houses your Midheaven falls in your {house_ord} house, which adds {house_theme} to your career themes.
connective_templates.stellium_count: In your chart that cluster is {n} planets: {planets}.

house_themes.3: communication, learning and siblings or neighbours
house_themes.8: intimacy, shared resources and deep change
house_themes.12: solitude, rest and the inner life

free: Existing Rising sign card in full (unchanged app copy).
One-sentence combined teaser: the share_line of the matching sun_rising entry (solar mode: the share_line of the emphasis entry or, if none, of sun_house_01 replaced by the label).
Sun's house: title plus the first teaser_cut (2) sentences; the rest locked.
Locked-card TITLES only, in CMO order: Moon's house, Venus's house, 7th house ruler, 10th house/MC; then '+N more placements'.
Chart wheel blurred: house divisions visible, no labels or glyphs.
free_paid.paid: Everything selected by the slots, in priority order, plus the full wheel. Chart ruler card titled 'Your chart ruler: the planet that runs your whole chart'.
free_paid.locking: Locked text is never sent to the client before payment; the server returns only free text + locked titles (see spec).

sun_sign_ruler_row.tooltip_en: The planet linked to your Sun sign. Your chart ruler, which depends on your rising sign, is in your Star Map houses.

ui_labels.chart_ruler_card_title_en: Your chart ruler: the planet that runs your whole chart

prompt_use: When passed to the AI master prompt, send the selected entry ids, titles and bodies as grounding with: 'Use these as the only source for house and chart-ruler claims; keep the tendency framing; do not add predictions, health, money or legal claims; do not quote the library verbatim more than one sentence at a time.'
